purpose: Teach: 新聞紙/ナルニア/極上/旅立ち/母音/アイデンティティー/灯台/ピンク色

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新聞紙でお弁当を包んでお持ち帰りされたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer wrapped their bento in newspaper to take it home, Mei.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Gentle pause before the detail. Speaking as if sharing a small quiet moment with warmth, not seeking reaction.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、ナルニア物語の絵本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A child was reading through a Narnia book earlier.
lines.style: Warm and unhurried. Voice carries the tenderness of witnessing something small and genuine. Slight smile at the edges of the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニュー、極上の味だって褒めて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer told me the new menu item was exceptional — they really praised it.
lines.style: Pleased but understated. Light warmth on the praise. Not boastful, more like sharing something that landed well. Genuine satisfaction in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様の旅立ちを祝う集まりされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: There was a little gathering — they were celebrating a child's departure.
lines.style: Gentle and attentive. Voice slows on the word 'departure' with quiet reverence for the occasion. Noticing the meaning beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様に母音の発音を教えてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was teaching a child how to pronounce the vowels.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Voice carries the image of patient, quiet instruction. Speaking as if holding a tender moment in mind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の独自性、つまりアイデンティティーを大事にしたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want to hold onto what makes this place itself — its identity, you know?
lines.style: Thoughtful and searching. Slight emphasis on 'itself.' Unhurried pacing. Voice carries genuine care about preserving something that matters beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海辺の灯台のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was telling a story — something about a lighthouse by the sea.
lines.style: Quiet and reverent. Voice carries the weight of listening to someone's story. Slight trailing-off at the end, honoring the image.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店のロゴをピンク色にしたら可愛いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The logo would look lovely in pink, don't you think?
lines.style: Warm and inviting. Light, gentle lift on the question. Voice carries quiet delight in imagining the possibility together.
